recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12343 unless a future work group decision changes the Endpoint.address model or DICOM endpoint construction guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-12343 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request for DSTU2 asking Endpoint.address to be clarified as the service base URL only, without parameters, sub-services, or resource-specific path segments; its resolution said the description and notes would be updated to clarify that intent.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-12343. The WADO-RS Endpoint example with a base-only address was added in historical Endpoint/imaging example work, and the current StructureDefinition source already contains the requested base-address comment as of the post-R4B source rework; later commits only preserved or escaped that wording.
additional_context: Endpoint is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. The current endpoint example list includes endpoint-example-wadors, whose address is the base https://pacs.hospital.org/wado-rs. Later ImagingStudy endpoint notes and applied R6 issues in the same DICOM endpoint family state that retrieval URLs are constructed by appending paths or query parameters to Endpoint.address, which reinforces rather than conflicts with the seed decision. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no discussion that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already conveys the required rule and examples. Adding duplicate narrative would not change implementer understanding and would increase maintenance drift.

related_jiras.note: ImagingManifest/ImagingStudy endpoint work established DICOM Endpoint use and WADO endpoint context, but it is a broader Imaging Integration change rather than a separate decision for this seed.
R6 ImagingStudy clarification says retrieval URLs are constructed from the Endpoint.address base URL, supporting the seed interpretation.
R6 ImagingStudy editorial correction in the same endpoint-notes grouping; it does not require any Endpoint source change.
